summary: Round-2 fixes correctly address all three actionable round-1 minors and add the requested watcher-lifecycle test. (1) AC19 modal-copy assertion now uses toContain on the full canonical uk.json body 'Відключити бота @SmokeBot? Вхідні повідомлення припиняться, а вебхук буде видалено. Підключити знову можна будь-коли.' — byte-for-byte match with bot.disconnect.modal.body after {username} interpolation (verified against uk.json:241). A regression that drops the second clause would now fail. (2) AC17 token-regex negative assertion is added on line 382 inside the 'renders Connected view from initial fetch' test (`expect(wrapper.text()).not.toMatch(TOKEN_REGEX)`), closing the Connected-view leak gap that previously relied solely on the AC18 literal-string check. (3) Teleport stub is fully migrated off vue-test-utils' shared config object — the module-level `config.global.stubs` mutation is removed, the import of `config` is dropped, and a local `mountOptions` object is threaded through every single `mountSuspended(BotPage, mountOptions)` call (verified: all 21 mount sites pass `mountOptions`, zero leakage path remains). (4) The new 'modal closes when bot.current goes null mid-modal' test correctly exercises the full lifecycle: seeds `reactiveStore.current = BOT_FIXTURE`, opens the modal via click, asserts confirm button is present (modal-open invariant), mutates `reactiveStore.current = null`, settles, and asserts confirm button no longer exists (modal-closed invariant). It maps directly onto the new watcher in bot.vue (lines 30-35) that fires `showDisconnectModal.value = false` when `botStore.current` becomes null. Litmus test passes — removing the watcher body would leave the modal open and the assertion `.exists()).toBe(false)` would fail. Round-1 minor #4 (assertion-shape inconsistency in connect-error matrix) is intentionally not re-flagged per instructions.
